exposure: Indications for delivery (maternal, feto-placental, or mixed factors)
cohort: Pregnant women who received care from 2000 to 2010 and had early-onset severe preeclampsia, delivering between 20 and 32 weeks, excluding multiple gestations or major anomalies.
finding: Neonates delivered for feto-placental or mixed indications had significantly lower birthweight, abnormal cord insertion was more common with feto-placental factors, and women delivered for maternal indications had more significant lab abnormalities.
birth_weight: Significantly lower among neonates delivered for feto-placental or mixed indications.
